settingsHelp: AI checks the text before processing. You choose the actions and recipients.
noProvider: No AI API configured: requests are held for review.
providerHelp: Set the URL, model and key on the API server. Errors and uncertain results go to human review with no email or penalty.
penaltyPoints: Points deducted for discarded abuse (signed-in accounts; 0 = none)
reclassify: Reclassify if another subject is identified
routesHelp: All accepted requests stay in Messages → Contact. To send a copy, configure SMTP and enable the contact alert in the mail centre. Sending limits still apply.
queueHelp: “Needs review” is a separate moderation queue. After review, choose “New” to accept a request for internal follow-up. Editing a record sends no emails.
confirmPurge: Permanently delete this request and its follow-up note from the CMS?
balance: {score} points · {total} active note(s). The latest 20 are shown.
confirmRetract: Remove this note and restore its points?
